notes: CVE-2026-93687: Uncontrolled recursion stack overflow in braces <= 3.0.3 AST walkers. Upstream issue micromatch/braces#70 tracks the vulnerability. Transitive devDependency via stylelint in frontend. No upstream fix available yet.

CVE-2026-112366: picomatch vulnerable to ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs. Transitive devDependency in cypress, and transitive build-only optional dependency via @carbon/react -> sass -> @parcel/watcher in frontend. Static build output only; not executed in production container. No upstream fix available yet (<= 4.0.7 affected).
